verdict.rationale: Jira's materials say it can be extended with apps, point to 3,000+ Marketplace integrations and "rich APIs", and note that integrations can surface data inside Jira (e.g. development status). That implies third-party extensions can add UI within the product. However, nothing in the evidence describes a framework for building custom views or dashboard widgets, or a way to make them look and feel native; the cited views (boards, lists, timeline, calendars) are built-in, not custom-built. Missing for 10: documented UI extension framework or SDK for custom views, dashboard widget/gadget building, native design-system or UI-kit support for a native look, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
